text: Ramp - Composio Toolkit | Composio All Toolkits Ramp RAMP Latest version 20261104_00 Ramp is a platform that helps you manage your finances, track your income and expenses, and get insights into your business Copy page Authentication Details Composio-managed OAuth not available OAuth2 Frequently Asked Questions How do I set up custom OAuth credentials for Ramp? Ramp has no Composio-managed app, so you register your own OAuth app in Ramp and use its credentials in the auth config. You need Owner or Admin access in Ramp to see the Developer page. Create the Ramp app Sign in to Ramp. Click your profile icon in the top-right corner and select Settings . In the left sidebar, expand Company and click Developer . Under My apps , click Create new app . Enter an App name , accept the Developer Terms of Service, and click Create app . Ramp emails you a 6-digit verification code. Enter it and click Verify . The code expires after 5 minutes; click Resend for a new one. Open the new app from My apps . Under Redirect URIs , click + Add new URI , enter https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add , and click Add . It must exactly match the auth config's oauth_redirect_uri field, with no trailing slash. Under Grant types , turn on Authorization code , Client credentials , and Refresh token . Without the refresh token grant, connections stop working when the access token expires. Copy the Client ID . Reveal the Client secret with the eye icon and copy it. If you lose it, click Rotate client secret , then update the auth config and reconnect affected accounts. Under Scopes , click Configure allowed scopes , turn on the scopes you'll request, and click Set . Create the auth config in Composio In the Composio dashboard , go to Auth Configs → Create and select Ramp . Paste the Client ID and Client Secret. Set the scopes to the same set you allowed on the Ramp app. Check Base URL and Authorization URL . The defaults, https://api.ramp.com/developer/v1 and https://app.ramp.com/v1/authorize , are for production Ramp accounts. If you registered the app on a Ramp demo account (your browser shows demo.ramp.com ), use the demo-api.ramp.com and demo.ramp.com hosts instead. The wrong environment makes the token exchange fail. Click Create Auth Config , then Connect Account . Review the permissions on Ramp's consent screen and click Allow . Confirm the account shows Active on the auth config's Connected Accounts tab. See custom auth configs for the general flow. Scopes The default auth config requests read and write scopes across accounting, bills, cards, departments, limits, locations, memos, purchase orders, receipts, spend programs, users, and vendors, plus read access to transactions, statements, and other resources. Every scope the auth config requests must be allowed on the Ramp app, or authorization fails. Request only what your tools need, and remove from both sides anything you don't. If you request accounting:write and the Ramp account already has an accounting provider connected, Ramp's consent screen warns that granting it may conflict. Remove accounting:write from both the Ramp app and the auth config if you don't need it. Troubleshooting redirect_uri_mismatch : the redirect URI in Ramp doesn't exactly match the auth config's. Token exchange fails : the Base URL and Authorization URL point to the wrong Ramp environment (demo or production). Connection goes inactive : turn on the Refresh token grant type on the Ramp app, then reconnect from the auth config. No Developer page : ask a Ramp owner for the Owner or Admin role.
